shortDescription: This module manages IP provisioning on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: gateway
options.description: Specifies the gateway address. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: node
options.description: Specifies the name of the node.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies a port ranging from 1 - 16 to which IP shall be assigned.

options.name: portset
options.description: Specifies the name of the portset object.

options.name: shareip
options.description: Specifies the flag when IP is shared between multiple portsets. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or removes (C(absent)) an IP address.

options.name: subnet_prefix
options.description: Specifies the prefix of subnet mask. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: vlan
options.description: Specifies a vlan id ranging from 1 - 4096. Applies when I(state=present).
